title: Suno's Leaked Files: Why the AI Music Scandal Is a Moment of Truth for Fair Use
angle: The bombshell leak allegedly showing Suno scraped YouTube isn't just about one company; it's the opening battle in a war that will define the legality of training AI on public data and could upend the entire generative AI industry.
rationale: This is the day's biggest AI drama, hitting the intersection of tech, law, and ethics, guaranteeing high engagement.
